comments.content: I left a few comments to add documentation but in general a good job!

If I understand correctly, the syntax is: first value ISSUE / REVIEW , depends on location where the comment is located. Second value on the person: ISSUER /  ASSIGNEE / COLLABORATOR / CONTRIBUTOR . Third value depends on the action COMMENTED / SPECIFICATION / TASK (perhaps SPECIFIED / TASK_CREATED would be more clear but I think we can leave as is) . Therefore in general this is a triple [ location / person / action ] . Would be good to put this information into a readme or instruction somewhere.
